storyline.real: Verstappen wins a wet race at Hockenheim, through a spin and several safety cars; Vettel climbs from last on the grid to second.

mastery.label: Win on four more stops, as Verstappen made

eras.briefing: Hockenheim, 2019. Rain before the start: the race begins behind the safety car, with every car on wet tyres. Hamilton is on pole, Verstappen second. The track will dry, and then not quite.
